description: This is a Perl script for creating firmware images for Broadcom-based devices, replacing the brcmImagebuilder. It handles reading image files, padding, and constructing firmware headers with specific configurations.

methods.name: Read_Image
methods.description: Reads entire contents of a file into a scalar buffer.

methods.name: Padlen
methods.description: Calculates padding length needed to align data.

methods.name: Pad
methods.description: Pads a buffer with 0xFF bytes to align to specified block size.

methods.name: bcmImage
methods.description: Constructs and writes a Broadcom firmware image with headers and payloads.
